title: Turtle reading a book
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- shell -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='30' ry='22' fill='#2e8b57'/>
  <!-- shell pattern -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='20' ry='14' fill='#3cb371'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='11' ry='7' fill='#5fbf8f'/>
  <!-- shell edge highlights -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='30' ry='22' fill='none' stroke='#8fdf9f' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='20' ry='14' fill='none' stroke='#8fdf9f' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='38' rx='13' ry='12' fill='#7ec850'/>
  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='46' cy='35' r='2.5' fill='#1a1a2e'/>
  <circle cx='46' cy='34.5' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M45 40 Q50 44 55 40' fill='none' stroke='#3a7a1f' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- arms holding book -->
  <ellipse cx='32' cy='57' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#7ec850'/>
  <ellipse cx='68' cy='57' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#7ec850'/>
  <!-- book -->
  <rect x='30' y='50' width='40' height='22' rx='3' fill='#e74c3c'/>
  <!-- book spine -->
  <rect x='48' y='50' width='4' height='22' fill='#c0392b'/>
  <!-- book pages -->
  <rect x='33' y='53' width='14' height='16' rx='1' fill='#fff5e1'/>
  <rect x='53' y='53' width='14' height='16' rx='1' fill='#fff5e1'/>
  <!-- page lines -->
  <line x1='36' y1='57' x2='44' y2='57' stroke='#c8b99a' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='36' y1='60' x2='44' y2='60' stroke='#c8b99a' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='36' y1='63' x2='44' y2='63' stroke='#c8b99a' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='56' y1='57' x2='64' y2='57' stroke='#c8b99a' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='56' y1='60' x2='64' y2='60' stroke='#c8b99a' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='56' y1='63' x2='64' y2='63' stroke='#c8b99a' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='82' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#7ec850'/>
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='82' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#7ec850'/>
</svg>
